column1: # The renderer job's parts (.github/workflows/build.yml), each a process of build/test.py's --layout
# on lavapipe. A line holds a part's number, a test class or one case of a class by its display
# name, and its minutes on the runner, the least its tests took in the build runs of 6ae94ed5,
# db8afed6, 6677ae12, 7908f95a and e0618f1b, whose runners' processors drew one part up to 1.78
# times as slowly as each other, so the least stands for the faster processor. A class goes whole
# into a part, and global illumination's, the bounce rooms', the trees' leaves' and the trees' level
# shadows' by their cases. The lines are dealt from the longest into twelve parts, each to the part
# holding least, the trees' leaves never in a part with global illumination, so the parts come out
# alike, some 21 minutes each on the faster processor and 38 on the slowest. The part holding *
# takes every test no other line names, the classes that draw nothing, a class or a case added
# since, and the cases that skip themselves on a device that draws on the processor, its minutes
